structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters

law.catch_line: Impeding lawful fishing in tidal waters; penalty

text.section: It is unlawful for any person to willfully and intentionally impede the lawful fishing of any species of fish or shellfish. "Fishing" means those activities defined in § 28.2-100 as "fishing," "fisheries" or "to fish."
Notwithstanding any other provision of law, any person convicted of a violation of this section shall be guilty of a Class 3 misdemeanor.
